call_purpose: You called because your form was bringing in leads, but the autoresponder email was not going out to them.

resolved.text: Following our guidance, you switched on the autoresponder option in your form settings and saved it, then submitted a test form using your other email address and confirmed that the autoresponder email arrived.

covered.text: We explained that emails can sometimes land in spam, so it is good to verify your sender domain, which you can do in the email domain section of Settings.

customer_next_steps.text: Verify your sender domain in the email domain section of Settings.
